Builds directly on item 954's L1 seam. **THE CHANGE IS TWO EXECUTABLE LINES:** a new module constant `_AD_AXIS_CREDITED_DAMAGE_TYPES = frozenset({"PHYSICAL", "TRUE"})` in `hybrid.py`, and the filter inside `_physical_ability_damage` moving from `== "PHYSICAL"` to `in _AD_AXIS_CREDITED_DAMAGE_TYPES`. Everything else in the diff is docstring; the three gate sites are UNCHANGED because the widen is interior to the helper. **WHY TRUE:** `_mitigation_factor` returns a flat 1.0 for TRUE (`ability_dps.py:372-373`), so a TRUE row carries no resist derivative and cannot import penetration valuation. Proven by finite difference rather than by reading the branch - all 5 in-cohort TRUE rows measure dAP 0.0000 AND dVoid 0.0000 (Olaf E Reckless Swing, Vayne W Silver Bolts, Darius R Noxian Guillotine, Master Yi E Wuju Style, Garen R Demacian Justice). **WHY MIXED IS HELD - a decision, not an oversight:** the entire in-cohort MIXED population is Yone (W Spirit Cleave, R Fate Sealed); MIXED splits 50/50 armor/MR (`ability_dps.py:377`) so it DOES import magic-pen valuation, and a full credit moves his Void Staff #129 -> #111. Yone W and R genuinely ARE half physical, so the honest treatment is a 50% credit mirroring that same split - a separate design, not a filter widen, and deliberately left unbuilt. **WHY MAGIC IS PERMANENTLY OUT:** crediting it climbs Udyr's Rabadon's Deathcap **55 places** (#126 -> #71); the measured cohort MAGIC bucket is 97 rows / 57 champions / 457.3 DPS, **97 of 97 pen-positive**, +209.29 DPS from a single Void Staff. **BYTE-IDENTITY AT DEFAULT PROVEN TWICE, INDEPENDENTLY:** (a) a 92-champion cohort golden diff x 2 target profiles (tanky 100/60/2500/1200, squishy 30/30/1900/800) run on the SAME post-change code in both arms with only the frozenset swapped - flag OFF **0 of 92 changed**, flag ON exactly **5 of 92** (Darius, Garen, Master Yi, Olaf, Vayne), which is PRECISELY the TRUE-row set, with **ZERO top-1 changes**; (b) the full HZ-B1 + HZ-B2 regen (`--champions all` x 3 modes, 6 tables) differs ONLY in `engine_version` and `generated_at`. **THE MOST VALUABLE THING IN THIS ITEM IS A RETRACTION OF THE PREVIOUS ITEM'S OWN HEADLINE.** The 1.222.0 CHANGELOG (item 954) claims a "MANDATORY DAMAGE-TYPE GUARD" is what prevents an unfiltered term promoting Liandry's Torment to #1 for Aatrox. **That is FALSE and never held.** Aatrox has ZERO nonzero non-PHYSICAL rows (Q 16.2499 / W 2.6193 both PHYSICAL, E and R both 0.0000 at level 13 / empty build / tanky target), so the filter arms PHYSICAL, +TRUE, +MIXED and unfiltered all return the IDENTICAL number for him - the damage-type filter is inert on the very champion it was justified with. **The REAL protection is that the helper SUMS `per_spell`:** `item_proc_dps` (`ability_dps.py:1376-1381`) folds item burn and DoT into `total_ability_dps` and appears in NO per_spell row (measured Aatrox residue, total minus per_spell sum: **0.0000** on an empty build, **exactly 31.2500** with Liandry's 6653). **That protection was UNPINNED BY ANY TEST** - a refactor to `return result.total_ability_dps` would have silently restored Liandry's-at-#1 with no filter change visible anywhere in the diff, which is the worst shape a regression can take. Now pinned by `test_ad_axis_term_is_per_spell_sum_not_total_ability_dps`. The lesson is narrower than "verify claims": the 1.222.0 rationale was built on a REAL measurement (an unfiltered term does promote a magic burn item somewhere) attached to the WRONG mechanism, and nothing about the observation was wrong except the causal story bolted onto it. A rationale that names the wrong mechanism is worse than none, because it directs the guard budget at the inert half. **A SECOND WRONG LESSON WAS CAUGHT BEFORE IT SHIPPED:** "TRUE is AP-inert" is true ON THE AD BRANCH ONLY. Roster-wide there are 7 nonzero TRUE rows and **2 of them DO scale with AP** - Bel'Veth R (dAP +1.2153) and Cho'Gath R (dAP +0.6076) - out of reach solely because `_damage_axis` routes both to `"ap"` (Bel'Veth attack 4 / magic 7, Cho'Gath attack 3 / magic 7). **The axis split, not the damage type, is what makes this widen safe**; a future widen must re-measure rather than inherit the conclusion. **TWO SPEC DEFECTS, both authored against assumed data shapes:** (1) the planned Darius assertion was IMPOSSIBLE - Darius E Apprehend is None-typed but its dps is 0.0000, so excluding it removes nothing and total == credited == 9.8783, and `assertGreater(total, credited)` can never pass; the nonzero-exclusion proof moved to Udyr (R Wingborne Storm, MAGIC, 6.9413; total 18.1209 vs credited 11.1796) with a new `test_on_excludes_udyr_magic_ultimate` carrying the seam-level role. (2) a SECOND inlined copy of the old filter lived in `ComputeHybridSeamTests._phys`, not only in `AxisCharacterizationTests._phys_and_target` - a single-site fix would have left one test still asserting L1 behaviour. **RESET-OVERLAP (L2 part 2): INVESTIGATED, VERDICT UNRESOLVED-BY-DATA, NO CODE SHIPPED - and item 954's framing of it was itself wrong.** `basic` is NOT a reset marker. It is a flat, attack-speed-independent swing count (`total_attacks = basic + basicTime * eff_as`, `dps.py:555`) present on zero-reset champions (Jinx `basic:1`, Ashe `basic:3`, Tryndamere `basic:2`), so the whole 9-champion `basic >= 1` framing was reading a field that does not mean what it was taken to mean. Three population tests over 1399 rotation records / 173 champions ALL lean EXCLUDES: cadence-ceiling violations **8 total with 0** from the 9 reset champions; `basic/duration` for resets 0.2538 (n=68) vs control 0.2335 (n=1331), inside the control IQR; and the `sheen` cross-check finds `basic:0, sheen:1` on Ezreal Q and Gangplank Q, which ARE modified autos. It is NOT certifiable because **Nasus is authored BOTH ways in the same file** - two 1-second single-Q `sheen:1` poke rotations, `early[0]` with `basic:0` and `mid[2]` with `basic:1`, in the hand-authored `data/daemon_slayer/16.14.1/scenarios.json` with no enforced convention. Three population tests agreeing is not a convention when the source contradicts itself. **Exposure narrowed from 9 champions to 2 spells:** Vi E Relentless Force (110% total AD, 3.180 dps, **6.19%** of its combined term) and Renekton W Ruthless Predator (225% total AD, 1.190 dps, **2.35%**); Nasus Q is base-plus-stacks with NO AD ratio so overlap is structurally impossible, and Shyvana Q models the SECOND strike so it is disjoint by construction. A guard was proposed and **DELIBERATELY REJECTED** - it would string-match `empowers ... next basic attack` out of `effects_descriptions` prose, fragile and patch-sensitive, to correct an unproven ~6% error on one champion on a default-off path. Narrowing the exposure from nine champions to two spells and then declining to guard it is the correct outcome, not a failure to close. **NEW WORK ITEM FILED AS RM-98** (the tracker held the id; RM-96 Zilean + RM-97 Zyra went in batch32, so the next free GAP id is now RM-99, and RM-98 is NOT a champion GAP so it adds no roster checkbox): **the two summed terms are on DIFFERENT TIME BASES.** The ON path adds a GAME-AVERAGE ability rate to a COMBAT-WINDOW auto rate - `casts_per_sec` comes from `data/daemon_slayer/spell_cast_rates.json`, computed as `spell[1-4]_casts / game_duration_s` over 2851 matches, so it includes laning, recalls and death timers. Renekton W reads **0.0184/s** (about one cast per minute) while the rotation models `w: 1.5` casts in a 3-second window = **0.5/s**, a **27x** discrepancy. This systematically UNDER-prices the ability term relative to the auto term it is added to, distorting ability-item vs auto-item valuation. **SIZED, NOT ADJUDICATED** - the open question is which time base the summed term should be expressed on, not whether the gap exists. **Consequence: default-ON is now blocked on RM-98 on top of every standing L1 caveat**, since summing two rates on different time bases makes the flipped term's magnitude unmeaningful rather than merely uncertain. Live default-ON flip stays operator-gated. **Verification:** `agents/daemon_slayer/tests/test_ad_axis_ability_damage_rm39.py` now **37 tests** (was 32 at L1); DS directory suite **8632 passed / 1 skipped / 1998 subtests passed**, independently re-verified. Source: Riot Data Dragon 16.14.1.

954. DONE **2026-07-19 (RM-39/RM-43 L1 BUILT - the missing AD-axis ability term in `ds.hybrid`; ENGINE 1.221.0 -> 1.222.0, DEFAULT-OFF).** Tier-2. Flag-ON, 79 of 92 reorder; 4 top-1 changes, all squishy-only (Hecarim + Trundle BotRK -> Trinity Force, Jinx Trinity Force -> Heartsteel, Viego BotRK -> Manamune). **A PREDICTION MADE BEFORE MEASURING AND CONFIRMED:** the baseline sweep flagged that 4 champions are AD-axis only via the `0 <= 0` zeroed-DDragon-info tie (Akshan / Rell / Seraphine / Vex), three of which are really AP. Gangplank 133.2% and Garen 109.9% share the signature and both have `basic=0` rotations. **The process lesson is the same one item 953 recorded and it recurred anyway, in the opposite direction:** a conclusion drawn from a surface RATIO plus game knowledge, asserted confidently by two independent sources, refuted by ten minutes of reading the code. What settled it was asking for the code-level answer explicitly and allowing "undetermined" as an acceptable reply. **THE MISSING LOCK, now added:** the 30 new tests covered the damage-type filter and flag mechanics and NONE asserted the two terms price disjoint events - the single invariant the ON path's soundness rests on. Its first draft went red on a FALSE POSITIVE worth recording - a substring match on "rotation" swept in `stats_for_rotation["ad"]/["as"]/["crit"]`, which is the STATS mapping; tightened to a prefix match rather than loosening the assertion. **UNDER-CREDIT SIZED so a later widening has evidence rather than assumption:** of 368 per-spell rows across the 92 the split is PHYSICAL 177 / MAGIC 97 / None 85 / TRUE 6 / MIXED 3. Only 7 None rows carry damage and exactly ONE is a genuine undercount (Pantheon R Grand Starfall, ~1.0 DPS); Gwen Q and Skarner W are correctly excluded as magic. The helper docstring's own cited cases cost 0.0 - Aatrox E, Aatrox R and Darius E all evaluate to zero damage blocks, so that fallback is load-bearing against nothing. **The real excluded magnitude is TRUE and MIXED, not None:** Olaf E Reckless Swing at 17.1 DPS is the single largest excluded row in the cohort, larger than all None-typed physical undercount combined. **NOT READY FOR DEFAULT-ON**, and the residual is bounded rather than waved off: for 9 reset champions whose rotation carries `basic >= 1` AND a reset cast in the same window, the data alone cannot prove `basic` excludes the reset-consumed swing; a per-champion `maxOverlap` bound was computed (worst Zeri 66.9% of its ability term, negligible Renekton 8.3%). Six of ten carry it, across six distinct missing terms: AoE conversion (Soraka Moonstone), mobility (Sylas Rocketbelt), CC uptime (Swain Rylai's), team-wide damage amplification (Sona Bloodsong), ally-facing stats (Taric Locket / Knight's Vow / Zeke's), and ability haste as an enabler (Smolder Black Cleaver + Shojin). **CANONICAL INSTANCE = Soraka, the most extreme single measurement in the sweep to date: her 90.28%-presence near-mandatory first legendary Moonstone Renewer ranks #10 of 10, DEAD LAST in a closed ten-item pool**, while the engine's #1 Echoes of Helia is absent from her core entirely. The mechanism is **complementarity** - `ds.hps` prices each item's healing standalone and Moonstone scores lowest by that measure, but Moonstone is bought precisely because its rebound converts her strictly single-target W into an AoE heal engine, i.e. it supplies what her kit LACKS. RM-92 is L2 objective-coverage work like RM-91, and strictly larger - RM-91 needs one missing term, RM-92 needs a family. **SECOND, CHEAPER FINDING - a CANDIDACY gap rather than a ranking one: the carry pool is a fixed 111 items, byte-identical across seven marksmen** (Senna / Smolder / Sivir / Jinx / Caitlyn / Samira / Ashe) and **categorically excludes Black Cleaver, Spear of Shojin, Bloodsong, Stridebreaker and Sterak's Gage** while admitting Eclipse. This is a filter-list question, not an objective question, so it is likely the cheapest real win the sweep has produced. **Two by-design exclusions correctly NOT filed as omissions**, both caught by checking `gold.purchasable` first: Taliyah's Seraph's Embrace and Taric's Fimbulwinter are transform targets, the same rationale the enchanter guard test applies to Diadem of Songs. Measured consequence: **Randuin's Omen is engine #1 for all five and appears in the real core of NONE of them.** Shen is canonical - his ~27.3% near-universal opener Titanic Hydra sits #23 and his locked second item Dusk and Dawn is absent from the top-40. The finding is sharper than an omission: a modern support build is dominated by items `ds.hps` cannot represent by correct design, so her Echoes #1 "match" carries no information about her kit. **DATA-QUALITY WARNING banked: `data/meta_build/sr_champion_builds.json` can be wrong about which build is PRIMARY, not merely stale** - it lists Shyvana's core as her **5.06%** secondary path (Kraken / Dusk and Dawn / Sundered Sky) while the real primary is Trinity Force / Spear of Shojin / Death's Dance at **35.43%**; this batch's first probe ran against that wrong build and had to be redone. Keep it as a cheap cross-check, never as a substitute for the research agent. RM-81 currency recorded per champion (7 of 15 stale: Samira, Sejuani, Senna, Shaco, Shyvana, Sion, Skarner); every verdict here is an item-ORDER claim so none turns on a drifted damage magnitude, and Samira's entry says so explicitly so it is not reused for a burst-window argument later. Live DS confirmed 1.219.0 / patch 16.14.1 before any probe. Next up: Smolder. Next GAP spec = RM-92.

941. DONE **2026-07-18 (enchanter formulas-registry omissions closed - RM-90 / RM-86 finding (c), RC-2 pool work; ENGINE 1.218.0 -> 1.219.0). The request was "add the missing enchanter items"; the handed-down list of 10 proved roughly 80 percent WRONG, so the candidate set was re-derived from the catalog instead.** Scanned the WHOLE 16.14.1 item catalog for purchasable >=1500g items whose text implies heal / shield / heal-and-shield-power, rather than trusting the list. **TWO items genuinely belonged**, both pure AMP items with every proc field 0.0, both taking their STATED flat HSP stat exactly as every prior entry was curated (Ardent 10% -> 0.10, Staff 10% -> 0.10, Mikael's 12% -> 0.12, Redemption 10% -> 0.10): **Dawncore 6621** (2500g, maps 11/12/21/35, "16% Heal and Shield Power" -> 0.16) and **Whispering Circlet 2526** (2250g, same maps, "8% Heal and Shield Power" -> 0.08). **The engine then corrected a test expectation rather than the reverse:** Dawncore is TERMINAL (into=None) so it genuinely enters the ranked pool, but Whispering Circlet is NON-TERMINAL (into=[2530] Diadem of Songs) so the terminal-only candidate filter drops it from the RANKING exactly as it drops the already-registered component Forbidden Idol 3114 - registering it is still correct because `compute_hps` must credit its 8% amp when a real build holds it mid-transform. So the RANKED pool grows 9 -> 10, not 9 -> 11; the test was fixed to the measured truth. Dawncore behaves as an amp item should, climbing **#9 empty -> #8 after Echoes -> #6 after +Ardent -> #5 after +Staff** (delta 1.16 -> 8.88 -> 10.13 -> 11.43), the same shape Moonstone shows and the documented empty-build amp artifact. **THE EIGHT REJECTIONS ARE EACH PINNED BY THEIR OWN GUARD TEST so the category error cannot recur:** 3869 / 3870 / 3871 / 3876 / 3877 are the **World Atlas support-QUEST line** (all 400g with byte-identical stats, mutually exclusive starter upgrades, not legendaries - ranking them against 2200g legendaries is a category error); 3116 Rylai's / 4629 Cosmic Drive / 2065 Shurelya's / 3050 Zeke's Convergence / 4402 Innervating Locket carry **ZERO heal/shield/HSP** and adding them with all-zero formulas would score only incidental AP and rank them LAST, the identical pathology to flipping `enchanter_only=False` (which floats Rabadon's 4.370 above Mikael's 4.167); 4016 Wordless Promise and 4011 Sword of Blossoming Dawn are real HSP items but **ARENA-ONLY** (`maps` is {30} alone); 2530 Diadem of Songs is `gold.purchasable=False`. **THE UNEXPECTED RESULT, and the one worth carrying forward: an edit scoped to SR-legal items propagated into ARENA.** SR and ARAM build-order tables came back stamp-only as expected, but Arena moved 90 lines - `build_orders_arena.json` gained **226621** in 66 slots displacing 226617, plus a 60-slot Echoes reorder and 6 slots pushing 223107 out. Root cause: **the registry is keyed by BASE id and the map-30 mirror id-space (22xxxx) resolves through it, with nothing gating on DDragon `maps`.** The propagation was verified CORRECT here (226621 is a real purchasable TERMINAL map-30 item), but it was correct by luck rather than by construction and was caught only by reading the build-order diff line by line. Same class as memories `reference_items_index_alias_ids` / `reference_arena_boots_map30_mirror`. **Filed as its own task, NOT fixed here.** **This does NOT fix the enchanter invariance and a test PINS that it does not** - both additions are generic amp items, so all 8 probed enchanters still return one identical order; fixing that needs per-champion-DIFFERENTIATED pool content, which remains RC-2 work. Do not read this slice as closing RM-86 finding (c). **Two things left deliberately unmodelled rather than guessed:** Dawncore's First Light ("Gain 2% Heal and Shield Power and 10 AP per 100% Base Mana Regen" - its own 100% adds +2% for 18% solo, and an Ardent/Staff/Helia build pushes higher) because `heal_shield_amp_pct` is a FLAT field with no build-dependent term; and Whispering Circlet's Harmony, whose magnitude is stripped from the DDragon text so no number is derivable from shipped data. Also noted and filed separately: `enchanter_items.json` `_meta.patch` still reads **16.9.1** while living in the 16.14.1 directory, copied forward verbatim across five patch refreshes - the same SHAPE as the LEDGER 936 `prefer_cdragon_ratios` sidecar-pinning defect; left as-is because it records curation vintage and rewriting it would assert a re-validation of the ten pre-existing entries nobody has performed. Tier-2: DS suite **8542 passed** / 1 skipped / 1986 subtests (the docs count was derived as 8528+14 and then CONFIRMED by measurement), Share mirror re-synced (465 files), DS `:8893` restarted and serving 1.219.0, both build-order tables regenerated full-roster. Guard: `agents/daemon_slayer/tests/test_enchanter_pool_hsp_rm90.py`.

940. DONE **2026-07-18 (RM-86 L1 SHIPPED - the kit-conversion gate, default-OFF, ENGINE 1.217.0 -> 1.218.0; plus TWO corrections that invalidate parts of the spec it implements).** First engine change of the RM-86 arc after four read-only research batches. **NEW `agents/daemon_slayer/kit_conversion.py`** holds a per-champion CONTINUOUS conversion vector (`attack_speed` / `crit` / `on_hit` / `off_axis_stat`, each a fraction in [0,1]) plus `item_exposures()` and `conversion_factor()`; new param `kit_conversion_strength: float = 0.0` on FOUR rankers - `rank_items` (carry), `rank_items_by_burst` (assassin), `rank_items_by_ability_dps` (mage), `rank_items_by_ehp` (tank). The registry is consulted ONLY when the lever is > 0.0, so 0.0 does no lookup and no arithmetic - the `onhit_dps.py:494-496` byte-identity contract, not merely numeric equality. Rows keep their raw delta; only the sort key is scaled, and only DOWNWARD (a non-positive value passes through unchanged, because scaling a negative toward zero would RAISE its rank). **CORRECTION 1 - spec section 4's derivation source is impossible.** It proposed deriving the vector from the champion's own `damage_blocks`. Measured across ALL 1709 blocks / 171 champions: no attack-speed, crit, on-hit or DoT key exists for ANY champion. The complete key set is `ap_pct / attribute / attribute_kind / base / bonus_ad_pct / bonus_armor_pct / bonus_mr_pct / caster_armor_pct / caster_bonus_hp_pct / caster_bonus_mp_pct / caster_bonus_ms_pct / caster_max_hp_pct / caster_max_mp_pct / raw_modifiers / target_bonus_hp_pct / target_current_hp_pct / target_max_hp_pct / target_missing_hp_pct / total_ad_pct / unparsed_modifiers`. Attack speed appears ONLY as `attribute_kind="duration"` (AS the ability GRANTS, never a ratio it scales BY); crit lives in 6 `attribute` STRINGS and on-hit in 11, out of 570 distinct attribute values of which 439 are singletons and whose casing is inconsistent. The real signal is prose (107/171 champions mention on-hit in `effects_descriptions`) but **the loader DROPS that field** - `AbilityForm` declares 16 fields (`abilities.py:220-235`) and `from_dict` (`:237-263`) parses exactly those. The vector is therefore hand-seeded from verbatim prose per the `_passive_damage_overrides.py` precedent, which was forced anyway by the batch18-20 finding that five kits (Pantheon ~1/5 cadence, Rek'Sai, Rengar, Olaf, Riven) HAVE the term and must not be credited at face value. 8 champions seeded, each carrying its prose evidence in a `note` field; every unseeded champion resolves to the all-1.0 identity. Also corrected: the abilities snapshot holds **171** champions, not the 173 in `/health` (Locke + Zaahen absent, RM-79). **CORRECTION 2 - three of the section-8 acceptance anchors are UNREACHABLE by L1, and the reason is structural.** A monotone-lowering sort-key gate can only push bad items DOWN; it can never push a good item UP past untouched neighbours. Measured on live deltas and reproduced twice (offline simulation, then the shipped implementation, which agreed item-for-item): REACHED - Naafiri BotRK leaves #1 on carry AND assassin (#1 -> #24 both), Voltaic climbs #22 -> #12, Orianna Liandry's leaves #1 at strength 0.50 while Blackfire Torch is NOT suppressed with it, Poppy tank top-10 preserved. UNREACHABLE - Olaf Stridebreaker rising from #34 (it and BotRK BOTH carry `PercentAttackSpeedMod: 0.25`, so no attack_speed fraction separates them, and its real justification is Halting Slash's engage slow, for which no objective contains a term) and Pantheon Black Cleaver from #29 / Heartsteel leaving #3 (Heartsteel is pure HP, which is ON-AXIS for the bruiser objective, so exposure is zero on every channel and it FLOATS UP as neighbours fall - chasing it with a bulk channel would penalise HP for every real bruiser). Both filed as L2 objective-coverage work. **The Orianna separation is the design's hardest constraint and it holds**: both Liandry's and Blackfire carry a burn, so a DoT-keyed gate over-fires; the separation is that Liandry's spends 800g of its 3000g on HP an ability-DPS objective cannot read while Blackfire's 600 mana is mage-convertible - no champion-name list, no burn keying. **Strongest byte-identity evidence**: both build-order tables were regenerated full-roster (173 champions x 3 modes, precompute + variants) with the lever at its 0.0 default and EVERY table returned a 2-line diff, the engine stamp only - zero build-order content moved, which exercises the OFF path across the entire roster rather than the handful of champions the unit tests touch. **Also fixed a sibling test that did not test what its name claimed**: `test_coherence_off_is_byte_identical` (`test_onhit_dps.py:90`) asserted only that ONE item was present after a SINGLE ranking call, never building a second ranking, so it would have stayed green even if the `ap_ad_coherence=0.0` path stopped being byte-identical; it now compares the omitted param against explicit 0.0 over the full ordered `(item_id, delta_dps)` list and carries a teeth assertion, and was MUTATION-CHECKED (a deliberately reversed OFF path is caught, then passes again unmutated). **Deliberately deferred**: `hybrid` (bruiser), `hps` (enchanter) and `onhit` did NOT get the lever - no approved anchor needs them and the `off_axis_stat` channel is UNVERIFIED on those routes. Tier-2: DS suite 8528 passed / 1 skipped / 1960 subtests; RC suite 11888 passed with 16 failures triaged (13 were the ENGINE-bump stamp + doc anchors, regenerated and re-verified green; 3 are pre-existing flakes - the two `test_coach_poll_offload_hot03` cases pass in isolation and `test_ds_matchdb_mcp_server::test_http_auth_required` imports only stdlib/pytest/`tools.ds_matchdb_mcp_server`, a directory this diff never touches, failing with a local socket abort matching the known Vanguard/WFP loopback interference). Share mirror re-synced (`--check` clean, 464 files), DS `:8893` restarted and serving 1.218.0. Stale numbers corrected along the way: Olaf Stridebreaker baseline is **#34 not #33**; Olaf W attack speed is **40/50/60/70/80** pct not 50-90; Rek'Sai's "3 autos per Fury cycle" is NOT in 16.14.1 prose (Q reads "Her next basic attack", singular). Guard: `agents/daemon_slayer/tests/test_kit_conversion_gate_rm86.py`. Spec updated with a new **section 10** recording both corrections. **NEXT:** L2 necessity assessment for `ds.hps` (REFUTE condition 2 may already be satisfied - LEDGER 939 measured Locket 11.73 / Knight's Vow 10.00 / Mikael's 4.17 as literally CONSTANT across every enchanter, and a per-champion scalar amp multiplies constants equally and cannot reorder them), then L2 objective-coverage for the two unreachable anchors.

939. DONE **2026-07-18 (DS_SWEEP batch20 -> 114/173: Rell / Renata Glasc / Renekton / Rengar / Riven; FIVE GAPs, zero REFUTEs - the first all-GAP batch - plus a live user-facing defect and a retraction of my own batch19 finding).** Read-only research pass, no engine change. **Fan-out held a fifth session**: probes main-thread, 5 flat research agents with a hard no-sub-agent constraint, zero nested spawns. **RM-90 is a COHORT verdict, and it is the batch headline.** Verified directly against the shipped artifact `data/daemon_slayer/16.14.1/build_orders_sr.json` (DISPLAY-keyed, so the key is `"Renata Glasc"` with a space): **12 of 14 support champions ship exactly TWO distinct build orders.** GROUP A is byte-identical for Renata Glasc / Soraka / Janna / Nami / Lulu / Milio / Sona / Seraphine (Echoes of Helia -> Mercury's Treads -> Ardent Censer -> Staff of Flowing Water -> Redemption -> Moonstone Renewer, with ad_heavy / ap_heavy / balanced identical to each other as well); GROUP B is byte-identical for Bard / Taric / Rakan / Rell (Randuin's -> Mercury's Treads -> Warmog's -> Sterak's -> Jak'Sho -> Spirit Visage). Measured wrongness: Renata's shipped items are Echoes 1.09% / Ardent 5.6% / Staff 0.79% / Moonstone <0.5%, and her real core (Locket 69.5%, Imperial Mandate 44.8%, Shurelya's 27.8%, Bandlepipes 25.5%) appears NOWHERE; Rell's shipped items are all 0-3% for her while Zeke's 70.6% / Locket 64.1% / Knight's Vow 28.3% are absent. Four layers of cause: (1) `ds.hps` ranks a CLOSED 9-item pool (`enchanter_only=True`) excluding Zeke's, Bandlepipes, Solstice Sleigh, Celestial Opposition, Shurelya's and Vigilant Wardstone - `hps.py` ~894-907 documents the consequence itself; (2) inside that pool the order is champion-invariant (11 of 12 enchanters identical 9/9; Locket 11.73 / Knight's Vow 10.00 / Mikael's 4.17 literally CONSTANT for every champion, Rell the sole 7/9 deviation); (3) the tank route fails from the other side since a self-EHP objective cannot value ally-aura items; (4) the intended escape hatch RF2 is default-OFF **and** its table holds exactly ONE champion, Rakan, who no longer routes to `ds.hps` after Slice C moved him to tank - **so RF2 fires for nobody**. **The uncomfortable consequence, stated plainly: the Alistar / Blitzcrank / Braum / Bard / Rakan REFUTEs were too lenient.** "Correct axis, builds no damage, team-aura is a class-level scope limit" is still true but under-weighted the outcome - these champions receive a shipped build order omitting their 60-70%-pick first legendary. Rakan was already flagged in batch19 as the weakest refute in the class. New standing rule in the tracker: **do not rule another team-aura support REFUTE without first checking its shipped build order against real pick rates.** Filed as its own task; not fixed here (pool widening is RC-2 work, flipping RF2 is operator-gated). **Renata additionally CONFIRMS the earlier RM-84 "HELD as unrepresentable" call with numbers** - roughly 85-90% of her kit value lands on allies or enemies, and neither pool expresses Locket + Imperial Mandate + Shurelya's + Bandlepipes, so flipping her route swaps one wrong list for another exactly as that adjudication predicted. **Renekton carries the most direct falsification of a scorer output found so far: the engine's #1 pick is measurably his WORST item** - BotRK registers 4.2% pick at **48.0% win rate, the only sub-50% item on him** - while his 66.5% signature Eclipse sits #10 behind nine never-built items and Black Cleaver (60.6%) is #30. Also banked: Eclipse lost lethality in V14.1 and is now a BRUISER item, so an Eclipse-first build must not be read as lethality. **Riven is the strongest statement of RC-1 in the whole sweep, because the mechanic the sim credits is entirely real and entirely unbuilt** - her Runic Blade charged autos genuinely apply on-hit, ARE crit-affected, apply lifesteal at 100%, and proc Spellblade cleanly, so every precondition behind BotRK / Kraken / IE / Trinity is TRUE, and players build none of them (research named Trinity Force explicitly as "the notable trap"). Her whole top-10 is never-built and Axiom Arc #34 / Death's Dance #40 / Endless Hunger #41 are buried. The reason is CADENCE not mechanics: Q resets the attack timer, ability haste is the real throughput stat, zero attack-speed items appear in her data. **Rengar adds the fourth corroboration** (max Ferocity is 4, not 5, so empowered Q arrives ~once per four casts; Umbral Glaive 73.3% sits #13 and Profane Hydra 70.9% sits #38 while ~0% BotRK and Trinity lead). With Rek'Sai, Pantheon and Olaf that is **five kits that HAVE the on-hit/crit/AS term and must not be credited at face value** - the boolean-gate design for L1 is now decisively refuted. **Rell** is RM-90 cohort with a real but incidental Ornn/Rammus-style coupling (passive: bonus magic damage equal to 5% total armor + 5% total MR, plus a resist-steal she absorbs) that routes through autos only; her passive has EMPTY `damage_blocks`, the FOURTH such champion in two batches. **RETRACTION - batch19's Opportunity finding was WRONG and the task chip was withdrawn.** Opportunity (id 6701) was removed from Summoner's Rift in patch 26.09 for overlapping with Youmuu's; `items.json` carries `inStore: false` and `gold.purchasable: false`, and the map-30 alias 226701 is purchasable on Arena only. The DS candidate filter was behaving CORRECTLY. I asserted the defect from engine-side absence alone without checking buyability or live-game existence - a direct violation of the verify-before-declaring-broken rule, caught by the Rengar meta research. Artifacts: 5 verdicts + 1 cohort note in `docs/DS_SWEEP_TRACKER.md`, 4 `project_ds_sweep_*` memories, 1 task filed, 1 task withdrawn. **NEXT:** Rumble onward (batch21); next GAP spec = RM-91.

938. DONE **2026-07-18 (DS_SWEEP batch19 -> 109/173: Pyke / Quinn / Rakan / Rammus / Rek'Sai; 4 GAP + 1 REFUTE, two new spec numbers, and one champion that breaks the RM-86 L1 plan).** Read-only research pass, no engine change. Qiyana skipped as already FENCED. **Fan-out held for the fourth session running**: all engine probes main-thread, exactly 5 flat research agents each opening with a hard no-sub-agent constraint, zero nested spawns, zero limit kills. **Rammus displaces Ornn as RM-87's canonical example.** Production tank/ds.ehp is close to rank-INVERTED at the extremes for him: his **92%-pick effectively-mandatory Thornmail sits #20** while **three items totalling under 1.6% combined pick occupy #2/#5/#9** (Warmog's 0.35%, Heartsteel 0.85%, Spirit Visage 0.33%). Mechanism measured, not inferred: passive Spiked Shell grants bonus AD equal to 15% TOTAL armor + 15% TOTAL magic resist, W turns armor A into 1.6A+47 at rank 5 so passive AD = 0.24A+7 (**about +24 AD per 100 armor**), and **bonus HEALTH contributes ZERO to every damage source in his kit** - so a self-EHP objective, which rewards health at high resist values, pushes toward exactly the items real players avoid. **Quinn RM-89 is the most consequential verdict in the batch: she is the first champion measured carrying BOTH RM-86 root causes at once.** RC-1 - carry/ds.dps leads BotRK #1 / Runaan's #2 / Kraken #3 / Stormrazor #4, every one 0-2% real pick, because **Harrier is priced as attack-speed throughput when its proc rate is cooldown-gated and attack-speed-independent, and crit chance is a cooldown scalar that does not make it crit**; no reroute rescues her, all four routes still lead BotRK #1. RC-2 - her carry pool holds only 111 items and **structurally excludes Profane Hydra and Umbral Glaive**, both present in the 144-item assassin/onhit/bruiser pools, so her #2 signature item is not in the ranked set at all. **A perfect L1 conversion gate would suppress her three bad leads and still never surface her real second item** - section 5 predicted L1 makes RC-2 worse, and Quinn is the concrete instance. The spec's sequencing note now reads: L1 is necessary and provably insufficient. Also on Quinn: her role has FLIPPED to jungle ~55% / top ~32% (16.10-16.11 Harrier monster damage, 16.14 Harrier cooldown cut) and she is a lethality assassin at ~85-90% of real builds, ~0% on-hit. **Pyke RM-88 is a genuinely new shape: a throughput objective cannot price a discontinuous execute threshold plus a gold-and-reset economy.** Lethality quadruple-dips for him (damage, E stun duration, W move speed, R execute threshold at 1.5 per lethality, passive grey-health rate) and the engine models only the damage dip; ds.burst leads never-built BotRK #1 / Trinity #4 / Infinity Edge #7 over his real Umbral #12 / Youmuu's #15 / Edge of Night #19. His route is CORRECT and must not be re-opened - `axis_correct_archetype` catches the Support tag, live-confirming the RM-84 note that Pyke was never broken. **Recorded a correction so it is not re-derived:** his bonus-health-to-AD passive is NOT exploited (gold-neutral at ~37g per 14 HP vs ~35g per AD with zero durability, so strictly dominated); the load-bearing coupling runs the other way, grey-health cap = 80 + 800% bonus AD, so buying AD buys effective HP. **Rek'Sai is the third independent corroboration that L1's conversion vector must be CONTINUOUS, not boolean** - her unburrowed Q genuinely applies on-hit AND crits and she genuinely wants attack speed, yet her ds.hybrid top-9 is entirely never-built and her 67.1%-pick Spear of Shojin sits **#48**, because Q is only 3 empowered autos per Fury cycle. With Pantheon (~1/5 cadence) and Olaf (free kit AS) that is three kits that HAVE the term and must still not be credited at face value. **Rakan REFUTE doubles as the first post-hoc validation of a Slice C route override** - the RM-84 enchanter -> tank move is confirmed by research at roughly 10:1 (durability items ~167% combined across slots vs ~16% for the entire heal/shield shelf); flagged honestly as the WEAKEST refute in the Braum/Alistar class, since his two real first legendaries sit #16 and #23. **The invariance measurement was redone properly at scale** - 32 champions, 4 scorers, 8 per panel, 28 pairs each, top-8: `ds.ability` **8.00/8 set overlap (perfectly invariant - all eight mages get the same eight items)**, `ds.ehp` 7.57/8, `ds.hybrid` 6.04/8, `ds.dps` 4.54/8. This replicates RM-86 section 2's ordering independently on a panel four times larger, and adds a refinement: **`ds.dps` does not vary continuously, it bifurcates** into an on-hit-led cluster (Quinn/Vayne/Sivir) and a lethality-crit-led cluster (Jinx/Caitlyn/Draven), so a champion's build depends on which cluster its base stats land in - which is precisely how Quinn ends up served an on-hit list. **A data-layer limit that bounds any scorer fix:** three of the five champions carry their decisive mechanic in `effects_descriptions` prose with EMPTY `damage_blocks` (Rammus's armor-to-AD, Pyke's health-to-AD, Quinn's Harrier), the RM-81 false-negative class intersecting RM-86 - for them the conversion an L1 gate would need to read is not in the data at all, so L1 cannot reach them by any design. **Separate engine defect found via Quinn and filed as its own task (NOT fixed here):** the legendary Opportunity (id 6701, 2700g) is in the item catalog but enters **ZERO** ranked pools across 7 champions and 2 archetypes, while sibling lethality items appear normally - an RC-2 pool-membership defect. Artifacts: 5 verdicts + 1 method note in `docs/DS_SWEEP_TRACKER.md`, new **section 9** in `docs/specs/RM-86_scorer_kit_blindness_investigation.md`, 5 `project_ds_sweep_*` memories. **NEXT:** Rell onward (batch20); next GAP spec = RM-90. RM-86 L1 remains the highest-value engine work and now has both acceptance anchors and a proven insufficiency bound.

937. DONE **2026-07-18 (DS_SWEEP batch18 -> 104/173: Olaf / Orianna / Ornn / Pantheon / Poppy; ONE new spec number, RM-87, and a measured extension of the RM-86 invariance table).** Read-only research pass, no engine change. **Fan-out held again**: all engine probes in the main thread, exactly 5 flat research agents each opening with a hard no-sub-agent constraint, zero nested spawns, zero limit kills - third consecutive session with the discipline holding. **Four GAPs + one REFUTE, but only ONE needs a new number** - Olaf and Pantheon are the Aatrox RM-39 ability-bruiser family, Orianna is the Ahri RM-40 burst-mage family (sixth champion), so the batch17 convergence pattern repeats: the sweep is now mostly confirming known families rather than finding new defects. **Olaf is the most extreme RM-39 instance measured**: bruiser/ds.hybrid returns a top-6 in which every single item is one he essentially never builds (BotRK #1 <2%, Trinity #2 <2%, Kraken #4 ~0%, Heartsteel #9 ~0%, Liandry's #20 on a champion with zero AP ratios), while his entire real core sits #19-#43 with signature **Stridebreaker at #33**; no reroute rescues him. **Pantheon supplies the numeric anchor RM-86 L1 was missing** - only his empowered W can crit or apply on-hit and the passive empowers ~1 ability per 5-cast cycle, so AS/crit/on-hit convert at roughly a FIFTH of face value; independent meta research reached RC-1's conclusion unprompted. That argues L1's conversion vector must be CONTINUOUS in [0,1], not the boolean has-an-AS-term gate the spec sketched. **Orianna splits a standing family belief in two:** the engine leads Liandry's #1 at a 3.3% real pick rate and buries her signature Luden's Echo #13 (GAP) - but Blackfire Torch #2 is NOT a defect, it is genuinely 31%-pick meta that OUT-WINS Luden's, bought for AP/haste/mana rather than a burn her kit cannot apply. The "Liandry's + Blackfire lead" is therefore TWO findings, and future burst-mage verdicts (and any L1 acceptance test) must score them separately or the gate over-fires. **RM-87 (Ornn) is the one genuinely new shape: the first ds.ehp gap that is an intra-pool WEIGHTING defect rather than an omitted off-axis core.** He builds zero damage items so tank/ds.ehp is the CORRECT axis (not the Amumu RM-44 / Cho'Gath RM-51 / Galio RM-55 omitted-AP-core shape - there is nothing off-axis to omit), but four sub-7%-pick items (Warmog's #2 at 1.9%, Heartsteel #5, Spirit Visage #8 at 1.0%, Dead Man's #10 at 1.7%) rank above his signature Sunfire Aegis #11, with Thornmail #20. Root cause is measured, not inferred: **E Searing Charge scales off 40% bonus armor + 40% bonus MR** and passive Living Forge inflates that same resist pool +10-30%, so resists pay TWICE for him while a self-EHP objective counts them once and under-ranks resist-dense items against health-dense ones. **The batch headline is the Ornn / Poppy matched pair.** Both route tank/ds.ehp and return the SAME top-6 in the SAME order; that invariance is CORRECT for Poppy (REFUTE - her real core occupies #6/#8/#9/#10 and never-built items are correctly suppressed at BotRK #73 / Liandry's #50 / Trinity #47, and crucially NO Poppy ability converts her own bonus HP or resists into damage, so a pure EHP objective is the right objective) and a DEFECT for Ornn. **This extends the RM-86 section-2 invariance table from top-5 to top-8 on two more scorers:** Ornn / Pantheon / Poppy rerouted to bruiser return an identical top-8 item SET (Ornn and Poppy 8-of-8 in ORDER), across a tank, a tank/fighter and an assassin/fighter - **and Olaf is the control that names the mechanism**, overlapping only 4-of-8 because his base AD/AS differ. That is RC-1 as a positive measurement rather than an absence: the champion enters the objective through BASE STATS ONLY, so similar base stats yield literally the same build. Standing rule added to the tracker: **adjudicate every ds.ehp and ds.hybrid verdict on whether the SHARED list happens to fit the champion, never on the list being champion-specific - it is not.** Data currency: Olaf and Orianna are both in the 23-champion 16.14 re-extract delta (item 936), and DS was confirmed live at ENGINE 1.217.0 / patch 16.14.1 BEFORE any probe, so no batch18 verdict rests on stale ability data. Orianna's R change landed upstream two patches before 16.14, so the re-extract brought RC current rather than introducing a new value. Still open: whether `ds.dps` models Vayne W as stat-independent at all.

But that report is **RATIO-only** - its 1,046 rows are ap_pct 660 / total_ad_pct 324 / caster_max_hp_pct 55 / bonus_ad_pct 7, with **zero `base` and zero `cooldown` rows** - so it structurally cannot see the two fields carrying the RM-81 evidence, and it is itself pinned at **patch 16.11.1** inside the 16.14.1 directory. Operator chose a THIRD path over both options offered: watch the wiki's `Special:RecentChanges` feed daily. **SHIPPED `tools/ds_wiki_staleness_check.py`**, which diffs stored base-damage and cooldown ENDPOINTS against the live `Template:Data <Champion>/<Ability>` wiki pages - a source RC already reads, so it needs **no CommunityDragon and does not touch the default-off `prefer_cdragon_ratios` cutover program**. Two modes because they answer different questions: `--recent` (1 API call, ~8 Data-template edits/day) is a FORWARD watchdog that stops NEW drift accumulating, and `--full` (~18 batched requests) finds drift already banked - the feed only reaches back ~30 days while the Meraki pin is ~11 patches old, so `--recent` alone could never have found Mel (reworked in February). Key source facts established and recorded in memory `reference_lol_wiki_access`: the wiki Data templates carry live `|leveling = {{st|Label|{{ap|X to Y}}...}}` and `|cooldown` params; **DDragon is NOT usable for damage because `spells[].effect` arrays are all-zero** (same family as the zeroed `info.attack/magic`), giving cooldowns only; and endpoints must be compared rather than interpolated arrays because `{{ap|}}` is linear while real per-rank values sometimes are not (Mel W is 38/35/33/29/26). **THE MEASUREMENT: 75 of 171 champions (44%) carry at least one drifted base-damage or cooldown value, 123 findings** - and **39 of the 86 champions the meta sweep had already adjudicated are among them**, plus 33 of 84 pending including the very next batch (Morgana, Naafiri, Nami, Nasus). **RECALL IS MEASURED, not assumed, thanks to an operator cross-ref suggestion (Liquipedia patch portal -> Riot official notes).** Riot patch-note pages are reachable directly and URL-predictable, with the changed-champion list in `h3.change-title`, giving an authoritative "who changed in patch N" set that neither the wiki RecentChanges feed (30-day window, editorial noise) nor a brute-force sweep can supply. Cross-checked on 26.14 the detector catches **7 of 9** checkable champions and BOTH misses are correct by-design exclusions rather than bugs - Seraphine changed an AP RATIO (50% -> 40%, the CDragon ratio report's job) and Jayce a defensive RESIST GRANT, neither a damage base nor a cooldown - so recall on in-scope fields is 7/7, with Locke correctly absent as the RM-79 missing-champion case. That cross-ref also FOUND and fixed a real recall gap: Data pages that hoist numbers into MediaWiki `#vardefine` variables (Garen R is `{{ap|{{#var:b1}} to {{#var:b3}}}}`) parsed to nothing, hiding Riot's 26.14 cut of 150/250/350 -> 125/200/275; `resolve_wiki_vars()` inlines them with no extra API call and recovered **4 champions and 14 findings** (71/109 -> 75/123), Garen now reporting exactly [150,350] -> [125,275]. Liquipedia itself was NOT adopted - its API 406s without gzip and carries strict rate-limit/UA terms, and it is only needed as a patch INDEX, which RC can derive locally. The detector independently reproduces both batch15 discovery cases through a completely different code path (Maokai Q base 65..245 -> 75..255; Mel W cooldown 35..23 -> 38..26, E 12..10 -> 11..9, R base 100..200 -> 125..275). TDD throughout: tests written red first; **the test suite caught two real defects during the build** - (a) a raising helper propagated to `main()`'s outer handler and returned exit 2 on a mere wiki outage, fixed by guarding the call site the way the sibling bridge-note/auto-refresh sites are, and (b) `_current_patch()` picked up the non-version `laning_scenarios` directory and sorted lexically (16.9.1 above 16.14.1). A third defect was caught by inspection and fixed with tests: the merge-on-partial-run logic lived in the drift-check wrapper, so running the tool's own `--recent --write` directly would have **clobbered** the 71-champion report down to ~7 and silently marked 64 champions current; `write_report(..., checked=)` now owns the merge for both paths, proven live (a `--recent` pass re-checked 20 champions, found 12 stale, and the report still held 71 stale / 109 findings with `_mode=recent+merged`). 37 new tests, ruff clean, DS suite 8502 passed / 1 skipped / 1948 subtests. No `ENGINE_VERSION` bump and no engine file touched, so no DS `:8893` restart was warranted; the new client function is additive and nothing consumes it yet, so RC behavior is unchanged. Also relocated the batch15 systemic prose out of the `MEMORY.md` index (it had grown to a single 3,129-byte line, 15% of the file, against the index's own one-line-per-entry rule) into the method memory - preserving the one fact that lived ONLY in the index (the precompute histogram BotRK 62 / Liandry's 53 / Randuin's 24 / Helia 16) - taking the index from 20.8KB to 17.0KB with all 178 links verified resolving. `docs/DS_SWEEP_TRACKER.md` gained a "Data-currency caveat (RM-81)" section stating plainly that this does NOT auto-invalidate the 37 affected verdicts (the bright line compares item ORDER against real-meta build data, and most deltas move magnitudes not the kit AXIS) but that any verdict turning on a damage MAGNITUDE should be re-checked.

CI green (ci + CodSpeed). The underlying Meraki DATA gaps (Corki/Yunara stale AD-growth, Locke/Zaahen absent kit) are UNCHANGED - they still resolve only when Meraki `latest` advances past content_patch 25.15; this fix only makes the engine degrade gracefully when kit data is absent. - **DS math sweep VERDICT: GAP CONFIRMED + SHIPPED (the R80/R85-foreshadowed sibling).** Frozen Heart (SR 3110 / ARAM 323110 / Arena 223110) "Winter's Caress" reduces nearby enemy Attack Speed by 20% (DDragon 16.13.1: "Reduce the Attack Speed of nearby champions by 20%") but was registered `defensive_only=True` NOTE-only -> the DS ranker gave its signature anti-AA aura ZERO effective-HP credit, though the item's +armor already counted.
- **The mechanic, grounded:** a 20% enemy AS slow means nearby enemies auto-attack at 0.80x RATE -> the RATE of incoming basic-attack damage drops 20%. Basic-attack damage is PHYSICAL, so this is the SAME physical-EHP effect as R80's per-hit basic-attack DR (Plated Steelcaps), just sourced from attack RATE rather than per-hit magnitude. It folds into the physical EHP denominator - the same layer + item-keyed lane as R77 crit-DR / R80 AA-DR (the champion percent-DR family is champion_id-keyed and structurally cannot see items).
- **Build (default-OFF seam):** NEW `ItemEffect.enemy_attack_speed_slow` (0.20 on 3110 + 323110 + 223110, appended at the END per the dataclass convention) + `ehp.item_enemy_as_slow_multiplier(item_ids, assume_item_enemy_as_slow=False)` + a physical-only fold in `compute_ehp` (both the main and `_blend_with_heal` denominators) behind the default-OFF `assume_item_enemy_as_slow` flag. A DISTINCT item-keyed lane from R77 `crit_damage_reduction` + R80 `basic_attack_damage_reduction` - each item carries only its own reduction, so the three seams never cross-credit and STACK multiplicatively (Frozen Heart AS-slow x Steelcaps per-hit AA-DR on a build with both).
- **Byte-identical OFF:** `assume_item_enemy_as_slow=False` short-circuits `item_enemy_as_slow_multiplier` to the identity 1.0 before any item is inspected, and the new field defaults 0.0 -> every other item + caller is unchanged. Ships DEFAULT-OFF (unlike the already-flipped R77/R80 B45/B46) pending its own live-gated flip. Armed: `0.20 x 0.5 AA-share = x0.90` physical denominator = +11.1% physical EHP.
- **Verification:** TDD RED-first (`test_item_enemy_as_slow_r86.py`, 18 tests, import-error RED observed before implement) + DSV9 end-append field-order guard co-fixed (`enemy_attack_speed_slow` is now the LAST ItemEffect field). DS suite green (8060 passed / 1 skipped / 1943 subtests); `ds_share_sync.py` regenerated Share/src (413 files) + `--check` green at 1.182.0; DS `:8893` bounced + confirmed live `engine_version=1.182.0`. Read-only verifier subagent CONFIRM 6/6 before commit.

696. DONE **2026-06-30 (R42 LOOP cycle 7 - DS engine fix: Yun Tal conditional-AS (Flurry) unit mismatch; ENGINE 1.156.0 -> 1.157.0).** `compute_dps` folded `cond_as` - a bonus-AS FRACTION returned by `effects.total_conditional_as` (Yun Tal Wildarrows Flurry, uptime-weighted ~0.08 = +8% bonus AS) - DIRECTLY onto the FINAL rotation attack speed (`stats_for_rotation["as"] + cond_as`). But `stats["as"]` is FINAL attacks/sec, which the engine resolves as `base_as * (1 + bonus_pct)`, so adding the raw fraction over-credited attack speed by a factor of `1 / base_as` (for a sub-1.0 base-AS marksman, a ~40% over-credit of the Flurry bonus). This is the IDENTICAL unit bug R7 (1.147.0) fixed for the per-stack `passive_as` seam - whose corrected fold sits literally ~20 lines below the cond_as path in `dps.py` and was the explicit pattern to mirror. **Fix:** scale the fraction by the champion's innate base AS before adding - `innate_base_as = (champ.get("stats") or {}).get("attackspeed", 0.0)`; `stats_for_rotation["as"] = min(2.5, stats_for_rotation.get("as", 0.0) + innate_base_as * cond_as)` - same 2.5 League hard-cap re-clamp. `raw_attack_dps` is unchanged (it reads the un-folded `eff_as`, so only `weighted_dps`/`phase_dps` move - the same surface R7 corrected). The explain note was repointed from `+{cond_as:.3f}` to `+{cond_as*100:.1f}% bonus AS (Yun Tal Flurry ~27% uptime, folded onto base AS)`, mirroring R7's note clarity and keeping the "conditional AS" substring the existing `Batch54ConditionalAsTests` note-presence test asserts. **TDD RED-first** `agents/daemon_slayer/tests/test_conditional_as_base_fold_r42.py` (2 cases): a `CondAsAddsBaseAsScaledFraction` regression mirroring R7's `SeamAddsBaseAsScaledFraction` - since cond_as has no flag (it fires automatically with item 3032), the identical-resolved-stats counterfactual is built by `mock.patch`ing `dps.total_conditional_as` to 0.0 (compute_dps is not memoized, verified), then a Dagger (1042, pure +AS) calibration point gives the DPS-per-rotation-AS slope `c1`, and the test pins `on.weighted_dps` to `predicted_correct = off + c1*(base_as*cond)` within 0.5% AND asserts `|on - correct| < |on - wrong|` where `wrong = off + c1*cond` (the raw-fraction magnitude) - so it tests the base_as-scaled magnitude, not just presence. RED confirmed on the buggy code (`on=63.659` over-credited vs `predicted_correct=62.721`, 0.94 gap > 0.31 delta); GREEN after the fix; the existing `Batch54ConditionalAsTests` + R7 `SeamAddsBaseAsScaledFraction` stayed green. **Dependent-assertion fix (in-slice, the engine change exposed it):** `tests/test_routes_ds_relscore.py::test_score_pct_equals_delta_ratio` failed `3032 score_pct 71.3 != 71.1`. Root-caused (NOT my fix nor a route bug): the `/api/ds-relscore` route computes `score_pct` from the UNROUNDED `delta_dps` (`routes_ds_relscore.py:195`) but stores `delta_dps` rounded to 1dp; the test recomputes `expect` from the rounded stored numerator AND denominator, so the two paths legitimately diverge by up to ~0.2 from independent 1dp rounding, and `71.3 - 71.1 = 0.20000000000000284` tripped the `delta=0.2` tolerance via float epsilon. My fix correctly shifted Yun Tal's DPS onto that boundary. Tolerance widened to `delta=0.25` (absorbs worst-case double-rounding + float epsilon; a real route inconsistency would gap far wider) with an explanatory comment. **ENGINE_VERSION 1.156.0 -> 1.157.0** (SOT `__init__.py` + 90 quoted assertion pins byte-bumped across the DS test tree, 0 stray verified by grep of the quoted literal) + `agents/daemon_slayer/CHANGELOG.md` + `Share/CHANGELOG.md` dated entries + `docs/DAEMON_SLAYER.md` status banner 1.156.0/7604 -> 1.157.0/7606 (the `tests/test_docs_daemon_slayer_drift.py` guard reads `__init__.py` so it would have failed the RC suite - caught + fixed pre-commit); `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` carries a pointer not a literal (WP-F6a) so its guard passed untouched. DS `:8893` taskkilled (PID 10312, via PowerShell - Bash mangled the `/F /PID` switches into `F:/` path junk) + relaunched via `schtasks /Run /TN RC-DaemonSlayer`, polled live to engine_version 1.157.0. `Share/src` mirror re-synced (`ds_share_sync.py`: 381 files + lolmath_ingest bundle + doc anchors; `--check` green). **Tier-2 verification:** DS dir **7606 passed / 1 skipped / 1943 subtests**; RC `tests/ --ignore=tests/daemon_slayer` **10128 passed / 2 skipped / 177 subtests** (fresh re-run after the relscore tolerance fix); a read-only `verifier` subagent independently CONFIRMED all 7 claims fresh (new test 2/2, ENGINE literal 1.157.0, 0 stray quoted pins, live :8893 = 1.157.0, Share `--check` in sync, the fix is base_as-scaled at dps.py:865-866 not raw, the regression has teeth). 684. DONE **2026-06-29 (Eliminated the on-screen / taskbar terminal-window noise the operator reported - two distinct Windows causes).** **(a) Per-edit console flash (`2903d802`).** The Claude Code hooks are invoked via windowless `pythonw.exe`, but each one shells out to a console-subsystem child (ruff via the `py` launcher, git, pytest, `powershell.exe`); launched from a parent with no console, Windows allocates a FRESH console window for the child - a visible on-screen + taskbar flash. The `Edit|Write` hook (`tools/edit_lint_check.py` -> ruff) fires on every edit, so it flickered constantly; `tools/precommit_gate.py` (commits) + `tools/rc_facts.py` (session start) + `tools/pytest_guard.py` (full-suite) flashed too. Fix: added `creationflags=getattr(subprocess, "CREATE_NO_WINDOW", 0)` to every `subprocess.run` in the four hook scripts (getattr-guarded -> `0` on non-Windows, cross-platform-safe). Mirrors `feedback_avoid_console_flash_legion`. Verified `CREATE_NO_WINDOW=0x8000000`, flag accepted, ruff still runs (exit 0). **(b) `DesktopWindowXamlSource` ghost taskbar entry.** Live window enumeration (Win32 `EnumWindows`) traced the phantom to `WindowsTerminal.exe` (a XAML-islands `Windows.UI.Core.CoreWindow`), launched by `svchost -k DcomLaunch` with `-Embedding` = COM activation, NOT a script. Root cause: the default terminal application was set to **Windows Terminal** (`HKCU\Console\%%Startup` `DelegationConsole`/`DelegationTerminal` = the WT handoff GUIDs), so any console spawn COM-activated a resident WT whose CoreWindow left a ghost taskbar button. Operator chose "switch to Console Host + close ghost": set both delegation GUIDs to the null GUID (= Windows Console Host / let Windows decide) and `taskkill /F /PID` the resident WT. Verified post-fix: 0 WindowsTerminal procs, 0 `DesktopWindowXamlSource` windows. Reversible (revert the two GUIDs or Settings -> For developers -> Terminal). Tier-0/1 tooling + a host-env preference; no engine / Share / RC restart. CI green (run 28412388038). Work commit `2903d802`.**

622. DONE **2026-06-25 (CI Watchdog ARMED - item 204 - via a self-gate-on-green redesign that needs NO branch protection. Operator chose "full live-arm now" over a dry-run soak; the do-not-flip-blind guard was discharged by de-blinding the arm live + a verified armed no-op against green main. 3 commits (`ceef7b33` self-gate, `0396f495` xml-fix, this ledger) + the operational arm; Tier-1 tooling, ENGINE untouched, no Share.**

    **De-blinding (verified live, NOT trusted from the plan doc).** The plan's arm step said "enable repo auto-merge + a branch-protection CI gate so `--squash --auto` merges only on green." Live probes corrected it: the repo has `allow_auto_merge=false`, main is unprotected (404), and it is a private PERSONAL account where classic branch protection is gated - so `gh pr merge --auto` would have merged a ci-fix to main the instant it was mergeable, BEFORE its CI went green. AND a required-check gate on main would have BROKEN the direct-push-to-main workflow (what items 619-621 used). Exactly the trap do-not-flip-blind protects.

    **Self-gate redesign (`ceef7b33`, +3 RED-first tests, 30 total, ruff clean, CI green run 28189959300).** Replaced `--auto` with an in-watchdog gate: after `gh pr create`, `plan_dispatch` inserts a `wait_checks` step (`gh pr checks <branch> --watch --fail-fast`) and `execute_dispatch` squash-merges (plain `gh pr merge --squash`, no `--auto`) ONLY when it exits 0 (all green); a red or timed-out check returns `action=escalate` and is NEVER merged. No `allow_auto_merge`, no branch protection -> direct-push-to-main preserved. CI's `pull_request:[main]` trigger gives the ci-fix PR real checks to watch. NEW `_STEP_TIMEOUTS` (claude_fix 600s, wait_checks 900s) since the 120s default cannot cover a headless fix + a full CI run; `ExecutionTimeLimit` PT10M->PT30M for the blocking wait; the pre-existing `MultipleInstancesPolicy=IgnoreNew` prevents overlapping armed cycles during it.

    **Operational arm.** Isolated worktree `C:\RC-CIWatchdog` (git worktree off origin/main, OUT of the live checkout); `RC-CIWatchdog` registered via `Register-ScheduledTask -Xml` (State=Ready, args carry `--arm`, repetition PT2M, ETL PT30M). XML gotcha (`0396f495`): the committed `encoding="UTF-8"` declaration broke `Register-ScheduledTask -Xml` ("unable to switch the encoding" - the PS string is UTF-16); dropped the declaration (`<?xml version="1.0"?>`), accepted by both Register-ScheduledTask and schtasks. Also fixed the stale `core.bridge.send` escalation line in the task description (bridge decommissioned, ADR-012).

    **Verified live.** Dispatch plan prints `... pr_create, wait_checks, pr_merge` with the merge `--auto`-free; an armed MANUAL run against GREEN main was a clean no-op (last-5 runs all success -> 0 failed selected -> NO audit line, NO ci-fix PR, NO branch, NO merge, LastTaskResult 0). 30/30 watchdog tests, ruff clean. Kill-switch: create `ops\runtime\ci_watchdog\HALT` or `Disable-ScheduledTask RC-CIWatchdog`. The FIRST real red main at HEAD is the live proving ground (HALT is the armed abort).

620. DONE **2026-06-25 (snapshot_panels at-scale flake fix - CI/Linux-validated re-attempt of the reverted 618 secondary). Fixed the Windows local-suite TIME_WAIT flake WITHOUT regressing the Linux CI render tests; 2 commits (`1a974bd9` re-attempt that re-proved the Linux break, `0fe7e3bf` the platform-scoped fix), CI green. Tier-1 (one test-infra file; no engine / DS / Share / ENGINE_VERSION). KEY CORRECTION: the 618 triage blamed the SSE gen-gating, but the HTTP/1.1 keep-alive ITSELF is the Linux culprit.**

    The session-scoped mock server defaulted to HTTP/1.0 (connection-per-request), churning thousands of sockets into TIME_WAIT and exhausting the Windows ~16k ephemeral-port pool mid-suite - the non-deterministic 5/10/27-failure LOCAL flake (memory `reference_snapshot_panels_session_browser_flake`). Re-attempt 1 (`1a974bd9`): HTTP/1.1 keep-alive (unconditional) + a disconnect-detecting heartbeat SSE hold (replacing the reverted gen-gating). Windows 274 passed x2, 130s->84s - BUT CI run 28159713805 showed `X panel snapshot tests` on Linux: 5 render tests timed out (spike_markers / ds_relscore / overlay_combat / header_single_row / player_gpi). GROUND-TRUTH CORRECTION of the 618 triage: BOTH keep-alive variants (gen-gating AND heartbeat) fail the SAME Linux render tests, while the HTTP/1.0 baseline passes - so the keep-alive ITSELF is the Linux break, not the SSE hold mechanism. Mechanism (visible as FileNotFoundError + BrokenPipe pairs in the CI log): the gitignored ddragon image mirror is absent on CI, so champion/item PNGs 404, and a 404 send_error on a PERSISTENT keep-alive connection raises BrokenPipe and wedges the small connection pool, leaving panels half-rendered.

    FIX (`0fe7e3bf`): the TIME_WAIT flake is Windows-only (Linux has a larger ephemeral range + TIME_WAIT recycling and never had it), so scope the keep-alive to the platform that needs it - `protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1" if sys.platform == "win32" else "HTTP/1.0"`. Linux keeps the proven-green HTTP/1.0 path; Windows gets keep-alive. Also reverted the SSE hold to the long-proven `sleep(15)` (both the gen-gating and the heartbeat release-mechanisms raced the Linux render and bought nothing; the SSE thread is a daemon + Connection: close, so a short idle thread is harmless). DEVIATION from the operator's literal "keep the HTTP/1.1 keep-alive (sound)" instruction, justified by the CI evidence that keep-alive is NOT Linux-sound; implements the intent (fix the flake without breaking CI) per `feedback_audit_proposals_are_intent`.

    **Verified:** Windows local snapshot_panels 274 passed x2 (keep-alive + sleep15); Linux CI run 28160673048 `+ panel snapshot tests` 274 passed in 155s (the 5 prior-failing render tests now green) + every other CI step green (py_compile / ruff / DS Share sync / hygiene / smoke+regression / mypy). CORRECTED the stale `reference_snapshot_panels_session_browser_flake` memory claim "CI runs no pytest" - CI DOES run the panel snapshot tests on Linux (confirmed via gh run watch on 3 runs this session).

    **Audit (3 parallel read-only agents, ~56 panels, disjoint slices).** Hunted 4 render-gate failure modes: (1) `[hidden]`-attr mount toggled via `style.display` (the ds_statcheck class); (2) positional-array-by-id index; (3) stale/wrong gate accessor; (4) unwired renderer (the item-594 aram_balance class). VERDICT: CONFIRMED_BUG = none. Every `[hidden]`-attr mount uses the `.hidden` property; every `style.display` site targets a non-`[hidden]` mount, or inline `style="display:none"` (cleared by `display=""`), or an `<img onerror>` / hover toggle. resolveChampNames callers all index positionally (`names[0]`/`names[1]`). Independently re-verified the ONE genuine `[hidden]`+`style.display` overlap MYSELF (`#am-spike-markers`, `index.html:2126` + `active_match.js:1062/1067`): NOT dead - `spike_markers.js:147` sets `blockEl.hidden=false` on the content path, removing the attr so `display=""` shows it. The R26 "bug isolated" claim HOLDS under the broader sweep.

    **The real find + fix.** Tracing `#am-spike-markers` surfaced a SYSTEMIC latent idempotency edge across the 3 ctx-driven active-match panels (spike_markers / spike_curve / draft_elo): each dedups its render by content SIGNATURE (early-return on unchanged sig), while the outer `active_match.js` `_render*FromCtx` HIDE paths clobber `mount.innerHTML=""` directly (e.g. `active_match.js:1062-1063`) WITHOUT the renderer - desyncing the stamped sig from the now-empty DOM. Build (lean-axis) agreement and the even<->hold mapping are untouched.

This is the all-source half that the per-spell self-amp `_ability_amp_overrides.py` (which amps only the caster's OWN one spell) can never express. `TargetVulnEntry` (amp, source_key, kind, note) + two registries by source kind: `_CHAMPION_VULN_OVERRIDES` (champion_id -> ABILITY mark) and `_ITEM_VULN_OVERRIDES` (item-id str -> ITEM-passive mark). `target_vuln_multiplier(champion_id, item_ids)` composes the product of `(1+amp)` over every mark the wielder owns (multiplicative per independent amp source; a unique item id counted at most once via a de-dup guard).

    **Ground-truth deviation (logged, not silent).** The director's directive named Imperial Mandate `4005` at 6%, but patch 16.12.1 `items_meraki.json` "Coordinated Fire" is a current-HP mark-DETONATION (allies that damage a marked enemy consume the mark for 10% of the target's CURRENT HEALTH as bonus magic damage, 9s/target CD), NOT a +X% increased-damage-from-all-sources multiplier. No 6% all-source value exists in the data to characterize against Meraki ground truth (the directive's own "using values from the current patch" + "TDD vs Meraki ground truth" clauses), so 4005 is recorded in `_NONFIT_VULN_CANDIDATES` (documented with its real mechanic, NOT seeded) rather than modeled as a fiction - a WRONG precompute is worse than none; it belongs in an ally-detonation seam (cf. allyamp.py), not this all-source-%amp registry. Mirrors the established `_ability_amp_overrides` INERT-with-reason / `_STAGED_AMP_CANDIDATES` doctrine.

    **Seam.** `dps.compute_dps` gains `apply_target_vuln: bool = False` (appended at END per Python conventions). When ON, `weighted_dps` + every `phase_dps` is multiplied by the composed mark multiplier (scaling the wielder's whole DPS output - autos + procs + the routed on_hit passive); when OFF (default) the multiplier is never resolved and the AA-DPS path is byte-identical. Models the fully-marked target at full magnitude (the `assume_takedown` / `assume_ability_amp` developed-fight doctrine); uptime gating (Vlad R cooldown, Evenshroud's 5s post-immobilize window) is a future live-consumer concern, not baked here.

    **TRUE root cause - WS mixed-content boot abort (`91cf480a` + `0a70a547`).** The overlay loads over HTTPS at `https://legion-rc:8888/?overlay=1` and `web/js/main.js` opened an INSECURE `ws://legion-rc:8891/push`. Browsers BLOCK mixed-content `ws://` from an HTTPS page for any NON-localhost host (only localhost/127.0.0.1 are exempt) - the block throws a SecurityError SYNCHRONOUSLY at `new WebSocket(...)`, called unguarded at boot, which aborted the rest of init INCLUDING the HTTP /api/state poll fallback, so the page stamped body[data-shell=overlay] but never rendered. The prior backgroundThrottling diagnosis (item 557, `8c7319f5`) was a RED HERRING, masked for months because the "test in a normal browser" step used 127.0.0.1 (exempt from the block, always renders). Fix: route the WS to `ws://127.0.0.1:8891` (exempt + co-located on this 1-PC box, plain ws works) + wrap connect() so a WS failure can never abort boot. An interim `wss://` attempt was reverted - :8891 has no TLS, so wss:// spammed ssl_client_socket handshake failures (net_error -100). LESSON (memory updated): test the overlay on the legion-rc origin, never 127.0.0.1. Also added defensive Electron occlusion switches (disable-backgrounding-occluded-windows / disable-renderer-backgrounding / disable-features=CalculateNativeWinOcclusion) to rc-shell as hardening (NOT the cause).
